product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)

honesty.status: general good practice, not a code reference; no figure is read from any jurisdiction's standard and no surface names a product, brand, fire rating or specification number. A real deployment replaces these with the local standard.

bare-slab.name: Power-floated bare slab
bare-slab.why: non-combustible with nothing underfoot to carry flame or spark

sealed-slab.name: Sealed concrete slab
sealed-slab.why: dust-proofed general working floor that survives point loads

broom-concrete.name: Broom-finish concrete
broom-concrete.why: traction outdoors and on wash-down ramps

epoxy-smooth.name: Smooth epoxy resin
epoxy-smooth.why: wipe-clean and chemical-resistant for controlled rooms

epoxy-quartz.name: Quartz-broadcast epoxy
epoxy-quartz.why: keeps grip when the process runs wet or oily

spill-berm.name: Bermed epoxy with coved edge
spill-berm.why: contains a spill at the room boundary until it is recovered

welded-vinyl.name: Welded sheet vinyl
welded-vinyl.why: particulates collect in joints, so the floor has none

esd-vinyl.name: Static-dissipative vinyl
esd-vinyl.why: bleeds charge to ground before it can find a spark path

rubber-dielectric.name: Dielectric rubber matting
rubber-dielectric.why: insulates the person standing at live equipment

anti-fatigue.name: Anti-fatigue matting
anti-fatigue.why: long standing bench work punishes joints on hard floor

firebrick-hearth.name: Firebrick hearth
firebrick-hearth.why: it will be spilled on, and must take molten metal

acid-brick.name: Acid-resistant brick
acid-brick.why: shrugs off the chemistry a plating or wash-down bay throws

steel-checker.name: Checkerplate steel
steel-checker.why: grip where machines drip oil, and it can be hosed

steel-grate.name: Open steel grating
steel-grate.why: the floor drains itself where water is the work

marine-deck.name: Non-skid marine deck
marine-deck.why: grip that survives immersion and salt

end-grain-block.name: End-grain wood block
end-grain-block.why: kind to a dropped edge tool, and quiet underfoot

timber-plank.name: Heavy timber planking
timber-plank.why: the substrate formwork and carpentry actually fasten into

raised-access.name: Raised access floor
raised-access.why: the services run under the floor, not across it

terrazzo-ground.name: Ground terrazzo
terrazzo-ground.why: a finish trade shows its own craft where people gather

porcelain-tile.name: Porcelain tile
porcelain-tile.why: hard, flat and truthful under a straightedge

crushed-stone.name: Compacted crushed stone
crushed-stone.why: the ground plant actually digs, piles and tracks on

asphalt-apron.name: Asphalt apron
asphalt-apron.why: the yard running surface between door and stockpile

painted-block.name: Painted concrete block
painted-block.why: the general working wall: takes a knock, takes a repaint

impact-block.name: Impact-faced block with kerb
impact-block.why: stock and plant hit this wall, so the bottom of it is the part that is built to be hit

liner-panel.name: Washable liner panel
liner-panel.why: a practice bay gets hosed out, and a lined wall sheds water instead of soaking it

ply-lined.name: Plywood-lined shop wall
ply-lined.why: you hang tools, jigs and a cut list off a wall you can screw into

whiteboard-panel.name: Full-height marker panel
whiteboard-panel.why: setting out is drawn before it is built, and the wall is the first place it gets drawn

matte-board.name: Matte low-glare board
matte-board.why: inspection reads surfaces at a raking angle, and a shiny wall throws the light back into the work

acoustic-panel.name: Fabric-faced acoustic panel
acoustic-panel.why: a room where people talk over each other is a room where the decision gets made twice

firebrick-face.name: Firebrick wall face
firebrick-face.why: the wall beside a pour takes the same spatter the hearth does

weld-screen.name: Non-combustible screened bay
weld-screen.why: the arc is not only the welder's problem: the bay walls stop the flash reaching the next bay

chem-tile.name: Glazed chemical-resistant tile
chem-tile.why: what the floor shrugs off, the splash-back has to shrug off too

coved-white.name: Coved cleanable wall
coved-white.why: a square corner is somewhere particulate can sit, so the room has no square corners

mesh-guard.name: Guarded mesh partition
mesh-guard.why: you have to see into a bay you are not allowed to walk into

provenance.discipline: RECORDED/DERIVED/SCHEMATIC tagging after the Locator.X rooms module (Apache-2.0)
